name: 363-talk
notes: #363 B7.a: two pairs chat at the green (activity Chat, partner set; no pair block, the chat is a function of the two keys and the shared clock). Talker bobs 0.02 u, every 2nd beat an open hand (right arm x78 z36); the listener nods 0.15 s after each talker peak (lean 4 to 20, squash .96; a double nod on the open-hand beat); turns swap every 2 beats; the last 1.2 s both laugh (bob 0.02 at 9 Hz, roll 5, lean -8, arms to the belly). The second pair stands 0.5 u away to show the pairs never bob in step. The last 0.5 s is a second Chat segment flagged endBeat (the laugh is the chat's end beat; the game has one activity).
